## 1. `UserResource.java`

**Path:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/UserResource.java`

```1:64:src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/UserResource.java
@Path("/me")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public class UserResource {
    // GET /me — returns username, name, email, roles from Keycloak JWT
}
```

Exposes `GET /me`. Reads `SecurityIdentity` + `JsonWebToken` to return `{ username, name, email, roles }`.

## 2. `ChatResource.java`

**Path:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/ChatResource.java`

```47:111:src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/ChatResource.java
@Path("/chat")
public class ChatResource {
    // POST /chat
    // Accepts ChatRequest (JSON), produces SERVER_SENT_EVENTS
    // Returns Multi<ChatEvent> — streaming SSE
    public Multi<ChatEvent> chat(ChatRequest request)
}
```

- Endpoint: `POST /chat`
- Request body: `ChatRequest` (see below)
- Response: SSE stream of `ChatEvent` JSON objects (`text`, `tool_start`, `tool_end`, `done`, `error`)
- Delegates to `ChatService.chatStream(request, userId)`
- `userId` resolved from Keycloak JWT `sub` claim, falls back to `"anonymous"` in dev mode

## 4. Model Classes

### `ChatRequest` — `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/model/ChatRequest.java`

```java
public record ChatRequest(
    String message,        // required — the user's question
    String productId,      // optional — scope to a product
    String conversationId  // optional — resume a prior conversation
) {}
```

### `ConversationSummary` — `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/model/ConversationSummary.java`

```java
public record ConversationSummary(
    String conversationId,
    String title,         // auto-generated from first message (truncated to 80 chars)
    String productId,
    Instant createdAt,
    Instant updatedAt,
    int messageCount      // total user + assistant turns stored
) {}
```

### `ChatEvent` — `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/agent/ChatEvent.java`

A sealed interface with 5 subtypes, discriminated by a `"type"` JSON field:

| Type | Record | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `TextDelta(type, text)` | Incremental Markdown text delta |
| `tool_start` | `ToolStart(type, tool)` | Claude is calling a tool |
| `tool_end` | `ToolEnd(type, tool)` | Tool call finished |
| `done` | `Done(type, conversationId)` | Stream complete; carries the conversation ID |
| `error` | `Error(type, message)` | Error during streaming |

## 5. `ConversationRepository.java`

**Path:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/agent/ConversationRepository.java`

Plain JDBC repository (`AgroalDataSource`) — **no JPA/Hibernate entities**. Key methods:

- `createConversation(userId, conversationId, title, productId)` — `INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`
- `appendMessages(conversationId, messages, fromIndex)` — batch-inserts new `MessageParam` rows as `JSONB`
- `touch(conversationId)` — bumps `updated_at`
- `renameConversation(conversationId, userId, title)` — returns `boolean`
- `deleteConversation(conversationId, userId)`
- `exists(conversationId, userId)` → `boolean`
- `loadMessages(conversationId, userId)` → `List<MessageParam>` (ordered by `sequence_num`)
- `listConversations(userId)` → `List<ConversationSummary>` (sorted by `updated_at DESC`)

There is no separate `Message` entity class — messages are serialized as Anthropic `MessageParam` objects into a `JSONB` column via `MessageSerializer`.

---

## 6. `ChatService.java`

**Path:** `src/main/java/com/eneve/agent/agent/ChatService.java`

Orchestrates the conversation flow:
1. If `conversationId` is provided and owned by the user → load prior history from DB
2. Otherwise generate `"chat-" + UUID.randomUUID()` and call `conversationRepository.createConversation(…)`
3. Auto-title = first 80 chars of the user message
4. Build system prompt via `PromptTemplateService` with key `"chat-system"`, injecting product/team/environment/Jira context
5. Run `ClaudeToolUseLoop.runStreaming(…)` (max 20 iterations) with read-only tools (`ToolDefinitions.chat()`)
6. `appendMessages(…)` + `touch(…)` after loop completes
7. Returns `Multi<ChatEvent>`

## 7. Database Schema — `V31__chat_conversations.sql`

**Path:** `src/main/resources/db/migration/V31__chat_conversations.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE chat_conversations (
    conversation_id  TEXT        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text,
    user_id          TEXT        NOT NULL,
    title            TEXT        NOT NULL,
    product_id       TEXT,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_conv_user ON chat_conversations(user_id, updated_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
    id               BIGSERIAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    conversation_id  TEXT        NOT NULL
                     REFERENCES chat_conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    message_json     JSONB       NOT NULL,  -- serialized Anthropic MessageParam
    sequence_num     INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    created_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_msg_conv ON chat_messages(conversation_id, sequence_num);
```

This is migration **V31** — the most recent among 31 Flyway migrations. Other notable tables include `agent_comments`, `ai_calls`, `review_memory`, `repo_settings`, `automation_hooks`, `jobs`, `job_history`, `code_graph`, `code_embeddings`, `knowledge_embeddings`, `prompt_templates`, `quality_reports`, `agent_settings`, `customer_registry`, `execution_plans`.

## Summary of Key API Endpoints

| Method | Path | Resource Class | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/me` | `UserResource` | Current user identity from JWT |
| `POST` | `/chat` | `ChatResource` | Start/resume SSE streaming chat |
| `GET` | `/conversations` | `ConversationsResource` | List user's conversations |
| `DELETE` | `/conversations/{id}` | `ConversationsResource` | Delete conversation + messages |
| `PATCH` | `/conversations/{id}/title` | `ConversationsResource` | Rename conversation |
